key_quote: No comparison with existing shape checking tools (TorchScript, mypy tensor plugins) makes it impossible to assess the marginal value of heavyweight SMT-based verification.
rationale: All three reviewers acknowledge the 5-theory product domain and IC3/PDR adaptation as novel contributions. The primary blockers are formal justification gaps (IC3 interpolation completeness, Lean mechanization scope ambiguity), missing baseline comparisons, and uncharacterized decidability boundaries — all depth/rigor issues, not novelty issues.
